name: Professor X

abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): En büyük tehlike vacilo (hata) efekti. Vigilance/monitoring yeteneği olan şampiyonlarla bu kolayca önlenir.
signatureAbility:
Krakoan Sovereignty
While below 75 Channeling Charge(s), gain 1 Charge(s) per second. While Defending, this rate is doubled and Charges are gained for the entire fight.
Gain up to +[10 - 50]% Prowess Potency, scaling with the Opponent's Power Meter.

abilitySections.title: Mutation - Always Active
content: Professor X's first Medium Attack is the only Basic Attack that makes contact with his Opponent. All of Professor X's attacks are Psychic and deal Energy Damage.
Immune to Reversed Controls due to his mastery over Telepathy.

abilitySections.title: Falter
content: When Professor X would be struck by a Basic Attack, he inflicts a Falter Passive, giving the Opponent's attacks a 100% chance to Miss for 2 second(s). This ability has a 20 second cooldown but starts on a 10 second cooldown.
When the Opponent lands a Special Attack, Falter is removed.
Avoiding an attack while Dodging backwards during Falter's cooldown reduces the duration by 1 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Persistent Cerebro Charges
content: Start each Quest with 1 Cerebro Charge(s).
Gain 1 Cerebro Charge(s) when Professor X wins a fight.
Cerebro Charges increase the potency of Professor X's Synergies.

abilitySections.title: Channeling
content: Professor X channels his telepathic abilities, gaining 10 Channeling Charge(s) per second at the end of his Special 1 and 2 Attacks and while charging his Heavy Attack.
When Power Burned or Drained, lose 50 Channeling Charge(s).
While at 25+ Channeling Charges, Professor X cannot be Evaded and gains a Vigilance Passive, allowing Attacks to bypass Miss. This will not trigger against Techs or those with #Psychic Shielding.

While at 50+ Channeling Charges, using the fourth Light Attack inflicts Mind Control on the Opponent. When activating a Special Attack with 100 Channeling Charge(s), automatically inflict Mind Control.

abilitySections.title: Channeling - Completing and Cancelling
content: Complete Channel or Cancel by Heavy Attacking: Gain +10 Channeling Charge(s).
Cancel by Blocking, Charging a Heavy Attack or using a Light, Medium or Special Attack: Gain a Prowess Buff increasing Special Attack Damage by 40% for 36 second(s).
Cancel by Dashing Backwards: Refresh the duration of all Prowess Effects on Professor X.

abilitySections.title: Mind Control
content: Mind Control lasts 0.5 second(s) for every 10 Channeling Charge(s).
The Opponent is Locked from gaining Power or using any of their Special Attacks.
Mind Control's duration is paused during Professor X's Special Attacks, except while Channeling.
Professor X's Special Attacks are Unblockable and cost up to 70% less Power based on the number of Channeling Charges. Reduced to 40% against Techs or those with #Psychic Shielding.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain 25 Channeling Charge(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The last three hits deal a burst of [9,151.2] Energy Damage. This ability scales with Special Attack Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a Prowess Buff for each Cerebro Charge, increasing Special Attack Damage by 60% and lasting 40 second(s). Max 4 stack(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Krakoan Sovereignty
content: While below 75 Channeling Charge(s), gain 1 Charge(s) per second. While Defending, this rate is doubled and Charges are gained for the entire fight.
Gain up to +[10 - 50]% Prowess Potency, scaling with the Opponent's Power Meter.
